address: Strathkinness Low Road, St Andrews, Fife,KY16 9TX
bio: Nestled in the Scottish countryside on the outskirts of St Andrews, Rufflets is an elegant Country House hotel surrounded by acres of award-winning gardens.  Afternoon Tea is served in the cosy Drawing Room and Library, where bright bay windows overlook the hotel's gardens, providing guests with a lush, green backdrop for their afternoon. Relax and unwind in this idyllic setting whilst indulging in the most delicious of Great British traditions.  Their Afternoon Tea menu boasts a delicious array of sweet and savoury treats. Feast upon dainty finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and a selection of mouth-watering sweets, including a decadent vanilla panna cotta and a tempting triple chocolate brownie. All of this is accompanied by your choice of Tea Lovers' Company Tea, of which all profits are donated to educational charities.  Rufflets Hotel is just a short drive to the centre of St Andrews, conveniently located for visiting some of the town's key attractions.
